input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship 8 (quick-pick-survey), item (e): the staged selector's switch rule above 120 items, then the default there
errors: First sweep launch (40 seeds, budgets to 1000, all lengths in one process) was too slow for the session; killed and rerun as 4 parallel processes with budgets to 600.
Pooled careless-pattern sweep stalled on long lists because selfConsistency refits each person; added --no-self and reran a narrower grid (150 items only; 300-item pooled cells not run).

doc_friction.issue: Its per-person self-consistency refit makes a 150-item panel run take hours; there was no flag to skip it (added --no-self).
simulate() returns states only at the end, so measuring several budgets meant either re-simulating or replaying history through applyComparison (the sweep replays; verified bit-identical).

goal: Deepen a flagship: land a measured, tested change to the survey's default question order on long lists
notes: Measured with scripts/long-list-switch-sweep.ts (new; 150/220/300/500 items, 30-600 answers, lapse 0 and 0.2, 60 paired seeds): information selector from the first answer vs the 120-answer warm-up -0.001 to +0.021 up to 120 answers, -0.015 to +0.014 after; ahead of shipped in 54 of 56 cells; couple bar 35 answers vs 38-40. Pooled (150 items, panels 20/60, careless random/salience): level or ahead of standard in 15/16 cells. Shipped: hybridSwitchAt 0 and defaultPairSelector staged at every length; survey builder labels and docs updated. New tests fail on the old rule (4 in pairing.test.ts, checked by restoring the old pairing.ts). Found: pooled 'clearly above' pairs wrong 5.4-14.3% on sparse 150-item lists under both selectors (vs ~0.5% on 15-30 items); recorded as next item (f) in flagships.yaml. Verification output: see the PR body and the commit that adds this record.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior data scientist: design and run a paired simulation sweep over 4 list lengths and a pooled panel grid, change the default with tests, write up (about two days)

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
